parts.desc: 这封信想干嘛：GET 拿、POST 交、PUT 改、DELETE 删
parts.desc_en: The request method describes the action: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.
The {c:url} identifies the destination; the path and query narrow down the resource.

parts.desc: 信封上的附加说明：内容类型、身份凭证、来源
parts.desc_en: Headers carry metadata such as the content type, credentials, and request origin.

parts.desc: 可选的数据载体，常见于 POST、PUT、PATCH 等请求；内容格式由 Content-Type 和接口约定决定
parts.desc_en: The optional body carries data, commonly with POST, PUT, or PATCH. Content-Type and the API contract define its format.

variants.when: 获取资源，并按接口约定在 URL 中传查询参数
variants.when_en: Obtain resources and pass query parameters in the URL according to the interface convention

variants.when: 交数据，内容放在请求体里
variants.when_en: Submit the data and put the content in the request body

variants.when: 更新已有数据，覆盖或局部改
variants.when_en: Update existing data, overwrite or partially change
Please be careful when deleting data.

use.t: 地址栏回车、普通链接导航通常发 GET：接口通常把它设计为读取，不应借此改变业务状态
{c:form} 默认会发 GET；配置 method="post" 才发 POST。登录、注册等操作常按接口约定把数据放在请求体里
调 {c:api} 出问题，先开 Network 面板看请求长什么样
可按常见约定用 PUT / PATCH / DELETE 表达更新或删除；也有接口因兼容性或动作语义使用 POST，先遵循接口契约

dont.t: 用 GET 传密码：明文留在浏览器历史和服务器日志里
给 GET 依赖请求体：规范没有为它定义通用语义，许多实现会忽略或拒绝；把参数按接口约定放进 URL
下单按钮只靠前端防重复点击：网络重试和并发仍可能重复到达；服务端要按幂等键、订单号或唯一约束保证同一操作只生效一次
接口报错时先检查实际请求，不要直接猜测前端问题

lessonPractice.title: 修改昵称后页面没变化，Network 显示 POST /profile 返回 400。下一步最该检查什么？

options.label: 查看这次请求带了什么，以及 400 响应具体说明了什么
options.feedback: HTTP 记录了浏览器实际发送和服务器实际返回的内容；400 表示请求未按约定被接受，应先读证据。

options.label: 只根据 400 显示“网络错误”，不再查看请求和响应内容
options.feedback: 400 已经说明服务器收到请求但不接受；忽略具体内容会丢掉字段或格式错误等可修复线索。

options.label: 把 POST 改成 GET，并把昵称写进网址后重新发送
options.feedback: 保存操作应遵循接口约定；随意换方法会改变请求语义，还没有解决原请求为何被拒绝。

en.title: After changing a nickname, the page does not update and Network shows POST /profile returned 400. What should be checked next?

options.label: Inspect what the request sent and what the 400 response specifically reports
options.feedback: HTTP exposes the actual request and response. A 400 means the request was not accepted, so the evidence comes first.

options.label: Use the 400 status to show 'Network error' without reading the request or response
options.feedback: A 400 means the server received but rejected the request. Ignoring details loses actionable field or format evidence.

options.label: Change POST to GET, put the nickname in the URL, and send it again
options.feedback: A save should follow the API contract. Changing the method alters semantics without explaining the rejection.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 保存昵称返回 400。请先查看实际请求的方法、网址、请求体和响应内容，指出服务器拒绝的具体原因，再做最小修改。不要把失败统一写成网络错误，也不要随意更换请求方法。修复后重新发送并确认成功结果。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Saving the nickname returns 400. Inspect the actual method, URL, body, and response, identify why the server rejected it, then make the smallest fix. Do not reduce it to a generic network error or change methods arbitrarily. Resend and confirm the successful result.

comparison.title: HTTP 和 HTTPS 有什么区别？
comparison.decision: 公开网站和线上服务应使用 HTTPS。它仍按 HTTP 规则传递请求与响应，只是在传输时增加了 TLS 保护。

dimensions.label: 是什么
dimensions.current: 浏览器与服务器之间收发请求和响应的通信规则
dimensions.other: 在 HTTP 基础上增加 TLS 加密与身份验证保护

dimensions.label: 传输途中
dimensions.current: 内容以明文传输，途经的网络设备可能读取或篡改
dimensions.other: 内容会被加密，并能发现传输途中是否遭到篡改

dimensions.label: 适用场景
dimensions.current: 本地开发与离线调试（如 http://localhost）
dimensions.other: 公开网站、用户登录、支付交互与生产 API

scenario.title: 线上环境提交登录表单
scenario.text: 使用普通 HTTP 时，途经的网络设备可能直接读到用户密码。HTTPS 会加密传输并验证连接的服务器身份，但不能修复服务器漏洞，也不能替代权限控制和数据校验。

use.t: Describe success, redirects, client errors, and server errors

dont.t: Use a successful status code for a failed operation
Change data with a request intended only for reading
Retry every failed request without limits
Log sensitive headers or bodies carelessly

comparison.title: HTTP vs HTTPS: what is the difference?
comparison.decision: Use HTTPS for public sites and production APIs. It keeps HTTP's request-response rules while TLS protects the connection.

dimensions.label: What it is
dimensions.current: The standard request-and-response rules between client and server.
dimensions.other: Standard HTTP traffic carried over an encrypted TLS connection.

dimensions.label: Data in transit
dimensions.current: Plain text; network observers along the path can read or modify data.
dimensions.other: Encrypted in transit; protected from eavesdropping and silent tampering.

dimensions.label: When to use
dimensions.current: Local development and offline testing (e.g., http://localhost).
dimensions.other: Public deployments, user authentication, payments, and production APIs.

scenario.title: Submitting a production login form
scenario.text: Over plain HTTP, network devices along the route may read the password. HTTPS encrypts the connection and verifies the server's identity, but it cannot fix server vulnerabilities or replace authorization and input validation.
